title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制~Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
focus: 以水線氣動機制、史庫頓數、表面處理、阻尼器與交叉索，診斷並抑制斜索的雨風振動~Diagnosing and suppressing rain–wind stay vibration through rivulet aerodynamics, Scruton number, surface treatment, dampers and cross-ties
summary: 雨風振動是斜張索在中等風速與降雨同時出現時發生的大振幅振動，1980 年代在日本名港西大橋首次被系統記錄，之後在諾曼第大橋與伊拉斯謨大橋等通車初期都曾出現。本課從上緣水線的氣動機制、史庫頓數門檻、HDPE 套管的螺旋凸肋，到外置與內置阻尼器的選型、交叉索、現場監測、自由衰減驗收、錨口彎曲疲勞與阻尼器維護，建立從量測到對策與驗收的完整流程。~Rain–wind vibration is a large-amplitude motion of stay cables that occurs when moderate wind and rain coincide; it was first systematically recorded on Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge in the 1980s and later appeared soon after opening on bridges such as the Pont de Normandie and the Erasmus Bridge. The course builds a full workflow from measurement to remedy and acceptance: the aerodynamics of the upper rivulet, the Scruton number threshold, helical ribs on HDPE ducts, selection of external and internal dampers, cross-ties, field monitoring, free-decay acceptance, bending fatigue at the anchor exit and damper maintenance.

units.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定~How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay
units.mechanism: 乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。下雨時，雨水沿傾斜的索面流下，在下緣與上緣各形成一條水線；上緣水線的位置由重力、表面張力與風的拖曳力共同決定，會隨索的振動在圓周方向來回移動。水線改變了斷面的有效形狀與氣流分離點，使氣動升力隨索的運動而變化，相位若恰好與速度同向，就等於負阻尼，把風的能量持續輸入索中。這種振動多發生在斜索沿風向往下傾斜、風速中等、雨量適中時，雨太大或太小、風太強都可能使水線無法穩定存在。~A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force. In rain, water running down the inclined surface forms rivulets along the lower and upper sides; the upper rivulet’s position, set by gravity, surface tension and wind drag, oscillates around the circumference as the cable moves. The rivulet changes the effective section shape and flow separation, so lift varies with cable motion; when it is in phase with velocity it acts as negative damping and keeps feeding wind energy into the cable. The vibration typically occurs on stays inclined downward in the wind direction, at moderate wind speed and moderate rainfall; too much or too little rain, or very strong wind, can prevent a stable rivulet.
units.model: 折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。若 f = 1.2 Hz、D = 0.16 m，風速 U = 12 m/s 時 U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5；若觀測的發生風速範圍為 8 至 15 m/s，對應 U_r 約 42 至 78。以 U_r 表示可把不同索徑與頻率的觀測放在同一張圖比較。數值為教學假設。~Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D). With f = 1.2 Hz and D = 0.16 m, U = 12 m/s gives U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5; an observed onset range of 8 to 15 m/s corresponds to U_r of about 42 to 78. Expressing data as U_r lets cables of different diameters and frequencies be compared on one chart. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。~Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature.
units.failure: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。~Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions.
units.misconception: 雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。~Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
units.practice: 斜張橋設計階段就要依索的傾角、方位與當地盛行風雨評估雨風振動風險，並在設計報告中列出每組索的對策（表面處理、阻尼、交叉索）與預留空間。~At design stage, assess rain–wind risk from each stay’s inclination, orientation and the local prevailing wind and rain, and list in the design report the remedy for each stay group (surface treatment, damping, cross-ties) with space reserved.

units.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入~The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input
units.mechanism: 史庫頓數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) 把索的單位長度質量 m、阻尼比 ζ 與空氣密度 ρ、索徑 D 合成一個無因次數，表示結構消耗能量的能力相對於氣流能輸入的能量。Sc 越大，雨風振動與渦振越不容易發展。長斜索的固有阻尼通常只有千分之一到千分之幾，Sc 往往只有個位數；工程上常被引用的門檻約為 10，表面經過有效處理時可放寬。由於 m 與 D 由結構需要決定，工程師真正能調整的是阻尼比，因此 Sc 準則直接轉化為「需要多少附加阻尼」的設計目標。~The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) combines mass per metre m, damping ratio ζ, air density ρ and diameter D into a dimensionless measure of the structure’s ability to dissipate energy relative to what the flow can feed in. The larger Sc, the less likely rain–wind or vortex vibration can develop. Long stays usually have inherent damping of only one to a few thousandths, giving Sc in single figures; a commonly cited threshold is about 10, relaxable where effective surface treatment is used. Since m and D are fixed by structural needs, the variable engineers can really change is damping, so the Sc criterion becomes a target for added damping.
units.model: 取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。固有阻尼 ζ = 0.2% 時 Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75；要達到 Sc = 10，需 ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%，即至少增加約 0.33% 的附加阻尼。數值為教學假設。~With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Inherent damping ζ = 0.2% gives Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75; reaching Sc = 10 needs ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%, at least about 0.33% of added damping. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。量測要涵蓋最可能被激發的數個模態，因為同一阻尼器在不同模態提供的阻尼不同。~Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes.
units.failure: 若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。~Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold.
units.misconception: 斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。~Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
units.practice: 斜索規格書應以 Sc 或最低對數遞減率表示阻尼要求，並註明適用的模態範圍與量測方法；驗收報告須逐組列出量測的阻尼與計算的 Sc。~The stay specification should express damping requirements as Sc or a minimum logarithmic decrement, state the applicable mode range and test method, and the acceptance report should list measured damping and computed Sc for each group.

units.anchor: 雙螺旋凸肋套管~Double-helix ribbed duct
units.title: 套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩~Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples
units.mechanism: 既然雨風振動仰賴穩定的上緣水線，最直接的對策就是讓水線無法形成。常見做法是在 HDPE 外套管表面擠出雙螺旋凸肋，雨水被凸肋打斷、沿螺旋方向分散流下；另一種做法是在表面壓出凹窩或其他紋理。供應商公開資料指出其主套管以雙螺旋凸紋打斷水流以限制雨風振動，阻力係數約 0.6；里翁—安提里翁大橋的斜索也以螺旋凸條保護。表面處理不需要維護機構，但會增加套管的風阻，使塔與橋面承受更大的風荷載，凸肋的高度與螺距需要在抑振與阻力之間取捨。~Since rain–wind vibration depends on a stable upper rivulet, the most direct remedy is to stop it forming. A common approach extrudes a double helical rib on the HDPE outer duct, breaking up rainwater so it spreads along the spiral; another presses dimples or other textures into the surface. A supplier states that its main duct uses double spiral threads to disrupt water flow and limit rain–wind vibration, with a drag coefficient of about 0.6, and the Rion–Antirion stays are likewise protected by spiral strakes. Surface treatment has no mechanism to maintain but raises duct drag, increasing wind load on pylon and deck, so rib height and pitch trade suppression against drag.
units.model: 斜索風力 F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L。U = 50 m/s（q ≈ 1,531 Pa）、D = 0.2 m、L = 300 m：C_D = 0.6 時 F ≈ 1,531×0.6×0.2×300 ≈ 55.1 kN；若處理不當使 C_D = 0.75，F ≈ 68.9 kN，增加 25%，全橋數百根索累積後對塔與橋面不可忽視。數值為教學假設。~Stay wind force F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L. With U = 50 m/s (q ≈ 1,531 Pa), D = 0.2 m and L = 300 m, C_D = 0.6 gives F ≈ 1,531×0.6×0.2×300 ≈ 55.1 kN; a poorly chosen treatment with C_D = 0.75 gives F ≈ 68.9 kN, 25% more, which summed over hundreds of stays is significant for pylon and deck. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以足尺或大比例的套管段在風洞中做人工降雨試驗，確認在發生區間內不再出現大振幅；同時量測不同雷諾數下的阻力係數，並把結果用於全橋風荷載計算。現場以監測確認通車後的風雨事件中振幅受控。~Test full-scale or large-scale duct sections with artificial rain in a wind tunnel to confirm no large amplitudes within the onset range, measuring drag coefficients across Reynolds numbers for use in global wind loads; confirm by monitoring that amplitudes stay controlled in wind–rain events after opening.
units.failure: 凸肋在運輸或安裝時被磨損、套管接頭處凸肋不連續，局部仍可能形成水線；若只看抑振效果而未計入增加的阻力，塔與橋面的風荷載與疲勞會被低估。~Ribs worn in transport or installation, or discontinuous at duct joints, can still allow local rivulets; judging only vibration suppression without counting the extra drag underestimates wind load and fatigue on pylon and deck.
units.misconception: 套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。~The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
units.practice: 套管表面處理的選擇要同時附上抑振試驗與阻力試驗報告，並在全橋設計中採用相同的阻力係數；安裝時檢查凸肋連續性與接頭方向，損傷段須依供應商程序修補，例如補焊螺旋凸條。~Select duct treatments with both suppression and drag test reports and use the same drag coefficient in global design; during installation check rib continuity and joint orientation, repairing damaged lengths under the supplier’s procedure such as post-welding helical fillets.

units.anchor: 外置黏滯阻尼器~External viscous damper
units.title: 外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼~External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping
units.mechanism: 外置阻尼器裝在斜索與橋面（或塔）之間，以一支黏滯阻尼器連接索上某點與固定支架。張緊弦理論顯示，阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼比約為阻尼器到錨點距離佔索長比例的一半，且只有在阻尼係數最佳時才達到。長索需要的阻尼器位置因此可能離橋面數公尺，要靠高支架或控制桅桿支撐。供應商公開案例中，亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋使用 7.4 m 高的控制桅桿支撐行程 ±920 mm 的油壓活塞，正反映超長索對阻尼器位置與行程的需求。~An external damper links a point on the stay to a fixed bracket on the deck or pylon through a viscous unit. Taut-string theory shows that the maximum added damping ratio is about half the damper’s distance from the anchorage as a fraction of cable length, reached only at the optimum coefficient. Long stays may therefore need dampers several metres above the deck on tall brackets or control masts. In a supplier’s public case, the Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge uses 7.4 m control masts carrying hydraulic pistons with ±920 mm stroke, illustrating what very long stays demand of damper position and stroke.
units.model: 最大附加阻尼 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。要達到單元 2 的 0.53%，需 x_d/L ≥ 2×0.0053 ≈ 1.07%；索長 L = 400 m 時 x_d ≈ 0.0107×400 ≈ 4.3 m。若橋面空間只允許 2.5 m，ζ_max ≈ 2.5/800 ≈ 0.31%，不足，需加交叉索或表面處理。數值為教學假設。~Maximum added damping ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). Reaching unit 2’s 0.53% needs x_d/L ≥ 2×0.0053 ≈ 1.07%; for L = 400 m, x_d ≈ 0.0107×400 ≈ 4.3 m. If deck space allows only 2.5 m, ζ_max ≈ 2.5/800 ≈ 0.31%, not enough, so cross-ties or surface treatment are needed as well. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 阻尼器出廠做力—速度、行程與耐久試驗；安裝後以人工激振做自由衰減，比較有無阻尼器時的阻尼比；支架本身以模態量測確認勁度足夠，避免支架振動吃掉阻尼器的行程。~Factory-test dampers for force–velocity, stroke and endurance; after installation run free-decay tests by manual excitation, comparing damping with and without the damper; confirm by modal measurement that the bracket itself is stiff enough so its own motion does not consume damper stroke.
units.failure: 支架勁度不足時，阻尼器兩端一起移動，實際消能遠低於理論；係數偏離最佳值太多，阻尼器變成近似固定點或幾乎不受力，附加阻尼都很小。高支架若設計不當，本身也可能成為新的振動源。~A flexible bracket moves with the damper so actual dissipation falls far below theory; a coefficient far from optimum makes the damper act almost as a fixed point or barely engaged, and added damping is small either way. A poorly designed tall mast can itself become a new source of vibration.
units.misconception: 阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。~Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
units.practice: 阻尼器配置圖要標示每根索的阻尼器位置比例、設計係數、行程與支架勁度要求；任何因景觀或交通需求而降低阻尼器高度的變更，都要重新計算可達阻尼並由設計者核可。~The damper layout should show each stay’s position ratio, design coefficient, stroke and bracket stiffness; any change lowering damper height for appearance or traffic must recompute achievable damping and be approved by the designer.

units.title: 交叉索：把單根長索變成索網~Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network
units.mechanism: 交叉索是在同一索面相鄰斜索之間加裝細索或連桿，把它們連成網。單根長索被分成較短的段落，低階模態的頻率提高，原本容易被雨風或橋面運動激發的低頻振動被移到較高頻率；不同斜索的頻率也不再各自獨立，彼此牽制，振動能量在網中分散。供應商公開資料把交叉索列為長索的選項，說明它能消耗能量、使斜索頻率與結構模態錯開並提高平面內勁度。交叉索的缺點是外觀、施工與維護較複雜，且交叉索本身在大振幅時可能鬆弛再拉緊而受衝擊，連接件要能承受反覆的拉力。~Cross-ties are thin cables or links fitted between neighbouring stays in the same plane, joining them into a network. A long stay is divided into shorter segments, raising the frequency of the lowest modes and moving easily excited low-frequency vibration upward; the stays’ frequencies are no longer independent but restrain one another and spread vibration energy through the network. A supplier lists cross-ties as an option for longer stays, citing energy dissipation, decorrelation of stay frequencies from structural modes and higher in-plane stiffness. The drawbacks are appearance, construction and maintenance complexity, and ties that slacken and re-tension under large amplitudes take shock loads, so connectors must withstand repeated tension.
units.model: 張緊弦頻率與段長成反比。索長 250 m、第一頻率 0.25 Hz，若在中點以剛性足夠的交叉索固定，局部段長 125 m，局部第一頻率約提高到 0.25×2 = 0.5 Hz；若在三分點各加一道，段長約 83 m，局部頻率約 0.75 Hz。數值為教學假設。~Taut-string frequency is inversely proportional to segment length. A 250 m stay with a 0.25 Hz first frequency, fixed at mid-length by a sufficiently stiff cross-tie, has 125 m segments with a local first frequency of about 0.25×2 = 0.5 Hz; ties at both third points give segments of about 83 m and about 0.75 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以索網模型計算加裝交叉索後的模態與頻率，並模擬大振幅時交叉索是否鬆弛；安裝時以預拉力確保交叉索在正常振幅下保持受拉，完成後量測索網的頻率與阻尼，並定期檢查連接件磨耗。~Compute modes and frequencies of the network with cross-ties and simulate whether ties slacken at large amplitudes; pretension ties so they remain taut at normal amplitudes, measure network frequencies and damping after installation, and inspect connector wear periodically.
units.failure: 交叉索預拉力不足時，大振幅下反覆鬆弛再拉緊，產生衝擊力使連接件斷裂；若交叉索斷裂掉落，可能危及車道，且原本被抑制的振動會突然恢復。~Insufficiently pretensioned ties slacken and snap taut repeatedly at large amplitudes, shock-loading connectors until they fail; a broken tie falling can endanger traffic, and the suppressed vibration suddenly returns.
units.misconception: 交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。~Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
units.practice: 交叉索的設計要包含預拉力、連接件疲勞與斷裂後的掉落防護，並在交接文件中列出每道交叉索的位置、預拉力與檢查方法；景觀影響要在設計初期與業主溝通。~Cross-tie design should include pretension, connector fatigue and fall protection in case of rupture, with each tie’s position, pretension and inspection method listed in the handover documents; discuss visual impact with the owner early.

units.anchor: 導管內阻尼器~Guide-pipe internal damper
units.title: 內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差~Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance
units.mechanism: 較短的斜索常把阻尼器裝在錨具上方的導管內，外觀幾乎看不到。供應商公開的選型表依索長分級：內置彈性體阻尼器適用約 80 m 以下、行程約 ±10 mm；內置油壓阻尼器適用約 80 至 150 m、行程可達約 20 mm；超過約 300 m 的長索則用外置油壓阻尼器，行程可達約 500 mm 或依需求訂製。內置阻尼器距錨點很近，能提供的附加阻尼有限，而且它所在位置的振幅雖小，仍可能超過行程。安裝時導管與索的同心度必須準確，否則阻尼器偏心受力、磨耗加速，甚至在靜止時就已用掉部分行程。~Shorter stays often have dampers inside the guide pipe above the anchorage, nearly invisible. A supplier’s public selection table grades them by cable length: internal elastomeric dampers for stays under about 80 m with about ±10 mm stroke; internal hydraulic dampers for about 80 to 150 m with up to about 20 mm; and external hydraulic dampers for stays over about 300 m with up to about 500 mm stroke or custom values. Internal dampers sit close to the anchorage, so their added damping is limited, and although amplitude there is small it can still exceed the stroke. During installation the guide pipe must be concentric with the stay, or the damper is loaded eccentrically, wears faster and may use part of its stroke even at rest.
units.model: 第一模態振型 y(x) = A·sin(πx/L)。若跨中振幅 A = 0.5 m、阻尼器在 x/L = 0.02，y = 0.5×sin(0.0628) ≈ 0.0314 m ≈ 31 mm，超過約 ±10 mm 的彈性體阻尼器行程，需改用較大行程的油壓型或限制振幅的配套措施。數值為教學假設。~First-mode shape y(x) = A·sin(πx/L). With mid-span amplitude A = 0.5 m and the damper at x/L = 0.02, y = 0.5×sin(0.0628) ≈ 0.0314 m ≈ 31 mm, beyond the roughly ±10 mm stroke of an elastomeric damper, so a longer-stroke hydraulic type or complementary amplitude limits are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝前量測導管與錨具軸線的偏差，確認在容許範圍；安裝後檢查阻尼器靜止位置是否在行程中央，並以人工激振確認阻尼器在設計振幅下不撞到行程極限；每次檢查記錄阻尼器的磨耗與漏油狀況。~Before installation measure misalignment between guide pipe and anchorage axis against tolerance; afterwards check that the damper rests at mid-stroke and confirm by manual excitation that it does not hit its stroke limits at design amplitude; record wear and leakage at each inspection.
units.failure: 導管偏心造成阻尼器單側磨耗，數年內失效；行程不足時阻尼器在大振幅下撞擊止擋，反而成為衝擊來源，並把彎曲應力集中在錨口附近的鋼絞線。~An eccentric guide pipe wears the damper on one side until it fails within a few years; insufficient stroke lets the damper hit its stops at large amplitude, becoming a source of impact and concentrating bending stress in strands near the anchor exit.
units.misconception: 內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。~Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
units.practice: 施工規範要訂出導管定位公差、阻尼器安裝時的索力與溫度條件，以及安裝後的行程位置檢查；維護手冊應規定開啟導管蓋檢查阻尼器的週期與判定標準。~The construction specification should set guide-pipe positioning tolerance, the stay force and temperature at damper installation and the post-installation stroke check; the maintenance manual should set intervals and criteria for opening guide-pipe covers to inspect dampers.

units.anchor: 雨量計與斜索加速度計~Rain gauge and stay accelerometers
units.title: 現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨~Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain
units.mechanism: 要確認斜索振動是否為雨風振動、判斷對策是否有效，最可靠的證據是現場同步資料。代表性斜索上裝雙軸加速度計，記錄平面內與平面外振動；橋上設超音波風速計量測風速風向，再加雨量計記錄降雨強度。只有當大振幅與中等風速、特定風向及降雨同時出現，才能歸因於雨風振動；若大振幅出現在無雨強風時，可能是抖振、乾索馳振或橋面運動引起的參數共振，對策也不同。長期資料還能告訴工程師哪些索最容易振動，作為優先加裝阻尼器的依據。~The most reliable evidence of whether stay vibration is rain–wind induced, and whether remedies work, is synchronised field data. Biaxial accelerometers on representative stays record in-plane and out-of-plane motion; an ultrasonic anemometer on the deck measures wind speed and direction; a rain gauge logs rainfall intensity. Only when large amplitudes coincide with moderate wind, a particular direction and rainfall can the motion be attributed to rain–wind excitation; large amplitudes in strong dry wind may instead be buffeting, dry galloping or parametric resonance from deck motion, needing different remedies. Long-term data also show which stays vibrate most readily, setting priorities for damper retrofits.
units.model: 由加速度換算振幅 A = a/(2πf)²。若加速度峰值 a = 5 m/s²、頻率 f = 1.1 Hz，(2π×1.1)² ≈ 47.8，A ≈ 5/47.8 ≈ 0.105 m，即約 105 mm；同樣加速度在 3.3 Hz 時振幅只有約 12 mm，所以必須同時看頻率才能判讀振幅。數值為教學假設。~Amplitude from acceleration A = a/(2πf)². For a peak a = 5 m/s² at f = 1.1 Hz, (2π×1.1)² ≈ 47.8 and A ≈ 5/47.8 ≈ 0.105 m, about 105 mm; the same acceleration at 3.3 Hz is only about 12 mm, so frequency must be read with acceleration to judge amplitude. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 確認各感測器時間同步、加速度計方向與安裝位置有照片紀錄；以事件觸發保存原始資料，並用頻譜與時間歷程同時判讀主要振動頻率、振幅與持續時間，與風速、風向、雨量做關聯分析。~Confirm time synchronisation across sensors and record accelerometer orientation and mounting position with photographs; store raw data on event triggers and read dominant frequency, amplitude and duration from both spectra and time histories, correlating them with wind speed, direction and rainfall.
units.failure: 若沒有雨量計，所有大振幅事件都無法分類，可能對錯誤的機制下對策；加速度計方向記錄錯誤會把平面內與平面外振動混淆，誤判阻尼器的效果。~Without a rain gauge, large-amplitude events cannot be classified, inviting remedies for the wrong mechanism; misrecorded accelerometer orientation confuses in-plane and out-of-plane motion and misjudges damper effectiveness.
units.misconception: 只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。~An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
units.practice: 監測計畫要列出感測器清單、取樣率、觸發條件與資料保存期限，並在通車初期至少涵蓋一個完整的風雨季節；監測報告要把事件依機制分類，作為對策設計與驗收的依據。~The monitoring plan should list sensors, sampling rates, trigger conditions and data retention, covering at least one full wind-and-rain season after opening; reports should classify events by mechanism as the basis for remedy design and acceptance.

units.title: 以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼~Accepting added damping by free decay
units.mechanism: 阻尼器或交叉索裝好之後，必須以現場試驗證明斜索真的得到足夠的阻尼。最常用的是自由衰減試驗：以人工或拉繩把索拉到一定振幅後放開，記錄振幅逐週期遞減的過程，用對數遞減率換算阻尼比。試驗要針對目標模態激振，並在低風、無雨時進行，以免外力干擾衰減曲線；振幅也要接近實際關心的範圍，因為阻尼器的摩擦與非線性會讓小振幅與大振幅的阻尼不同。驗收時把量到的阻尼代回史庫頓數，確認達到設計門檻。~After dampers or cross-ties are fitted, field tests must prove the stay actually has enough damping. The commonest is the free-decay test: pull the stay to an amplitude by hand or rope, release it and record the amplitude decreasing cycle by cycle, converting the logarithmic decrement to a damping ratio. The test should excite the target mode, in low wind and no rain so external forces do not distort the decay, and at amplitudes near the range of interest, because damper friction and nonlinearity make damping differ between small and large amplitudes. Acceptance substitutes the measured damping into the Scruton number to confirm the design threshold is met.
units.model: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n)。振幅 10 個週期由 100 mm 降到 30 mm：δ = ln(100/30)/10 ≈ 0.120，ζ = δ/(2π) ≈ 1.92%。代入單元 2 的參數，Sc = 60×0.0192/0.032 ≈ 36，高於約 10 的門檻。數值為教學假設。~Logarithmic decrement δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n). Amplitude falling from 100 mm to 30 mm in 10 cycles gives δ = ln(100/30)/10 ≈ 0.120 and ζ = δ/(2π) ≈ 1.92%. With unit 2’s parameters, Sc = 60×0.0192/0.032 ≈ 36, above the threshold of about 10. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每根受測索至少重複三次並取平均，檢查衰減曲線是否為單一指數（若出現轉折，可能是阻尼器摩擦或拍頻）；同時記錄風速與溫度，並把結果與阻尼器安裝前的基準比較，列入驗收報告。~Repeat at least three times per stay and average, checking that the decay is a single exponential (a kink may indicate damper friction or beating between modes); record wind and temperature and compare with the pre-installation baseline in the acceptance report.
units.failure: 在有風時做試驗，風的持續輸入使衰減變慢，量到的阻尼偏低而誤判不合格；或在兩個相近模態同時被激發時出現拍頻，用單一指數擬合會得到錯誤的阻尼值。~Testing in wind slows the decay through continued input and understates damping, causing a false failure; exciting two close modes together produces beating, and a single exponential fit gives the wrong damping.
units.misconception: 阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。~A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
units.practice: 驗收計畫要規定受測索的抽樣比例、激振方法、振幅範圍、天候條件與允收值；高空激振作業須使用經核可的設備與安全措施，由主管工程師核准後執行。~The acceptance plan should set the sampling rate of stays tested, excitation method, amplitude range, weather conditions and acceptance values; excitation at height must use approved equipment and safety measures, authorised by the responsible engineer.

units.title: 振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞~Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration
units.mechanism: 斜索振動時，索在錨具出口處被迫轉角，鋼絞線在此承受軸向應力之外的彎曲應力；振動頻率約 1 Hz 的雨風振動每小時就有數千次循環，累積多年後可能達到疲勞範圍。錨具出口通常設有導向器或濾彎裝置，讓轉角分散在一段長度上，降低局部曲率；供應商公開資料也提到為較大型鋼腱設置彎曲濾波器或導向器以限制彎曲應力。因此抑制振動不只是使用者感受的問題，而是保護錨口鋼絞線疲勞壽命的關鍵。~When a stay vibrates, it is forced to rotate at the anchorage exit, and strands there see bending stress on top of axial stress; rain–wind vibration at about 1 Hz produces thousands of cycles per hour and over years can accumulate into the fatigue range. Anchor exits usually have deviators or bending filters that spread the rotation over a length and reduce local curvature; supplier material also mentions bending filters or deviators to limit bending stress in larger tendons. Suppressing vibration is therefore not just about user perception but key to protecting the fatigue life of strands at the anchor exit.
units.model: 若某索每年有 50 小時處於 1.2 Hz 的雨風振動，年循環數 = 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000 次，20 年約 4.32×10⁶ 次，已達鋼材 S–N 曲線的高循環範圍；若加裝阻尼器使振動時數降為 5 小時，循環數降為十分之一。數值為教學假設。~If a stay spends 50 hours a year in rain–wind vibration at 1.2 Hz, the annual cycle count is 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000, about 4.32×10⁶ over 20 years, already in the high-cycle range of steel S–N curves; a damper retrofit cutting vibration to 5 hours a year reduces cycles tenfold. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以錨口附近的應變計量測振動時的彎曲應變範圍，配合監測統計的振動時數，以 S–N 曲線與 Miner 法則估算累積損傷；定期打開錨具保護蓋檢查錨口附近的鋼絞線、夾片與導向器磨耗。~Gauge bending strain ranges near the anchor exit during vibration and combine with monitored vibration hours to estimate cumulative damage by S–N curves and Miner’s rule; periodically open anchorage caps to inspect strands, wedges and deviator wear near the exit.
units.failure: 導向器缺失或磨損，錨口處鋼絞線在反覆彎曲下出現斷絲，斷絲又使剩餘鋼絞線受力增加；由於位置隱蔽，若不定期檢查，可能等到多股斷裂才被發現。~A missing or worn deviator lets strands at the anchor exit break wires under repeated bending, raising force in the remaining strands; because the location is hidden, without regular inspection the damage may be found only after several strands have failed.
units.misconception: 斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。~Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
units.practice: 斜索系統的疲勞試驗要包含錨口轉角條件，導向器與濾彎裝置列為可檢查與可更換構件；監測系統應統計每根索的大振幅時數，超過門檻時排入錨口專項檢查。~Stay-system fatigue tests should include anchor-exit rotation, with deviators and bending filters inspectable and replaceable; monitoring should count large-amplitude hours per stay and trigger a special anchor-exit inspection when a threshold is exceeded.

units.anchor: 阻尼器累積行程~Damper cumulative stroke
units.title: 阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查~Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks
units.mechanism: 斜索阻尼器是長期反覆運動的機械元件，其耐久常以累積行程表示：供應商公開資料列出內置油壓阻尼器約 30 km、彈性體與外置油壓阻尼器約 100 km 的累積行程耐久。油壓阻尼器的密封會磨耗漏油，彈性體會老化硬化，連接銷與支架會鬆動。阻尼器失效時外觀往往看不出來，斜索卻會在下一場風雨中恢復振動。因此維護要結合定期檢查、監測資料中的振幅趨勢與事件後檢查，並把阻尼器的更換視為設計年限內的計畫性工作，而不是故障才處理。~Stay dampers are mechanical parts in constant reciprocating motion, and their durability is often expressed as cumulative stroke: a supplier lists about 30 km for internal hydraulic dampers and about 100 km for elastomeric and external hydraulic types. Hydraulic seals wear and leak, elastomers age and stiffen, and pins and brackets loosen. A failed damper often looks normal, yet the stay vibrates again in the next storm. Maintenance therefore combines periodic inspection, amplitude trends from monitoring and post-event checks, and treats damper replacement as planned work within the design life rather than a response to failure.
units.model: 阻尼器處振幅 5 mm、頻率 1.5 Hz 時，每週期行程 4×5 = 20 mm，每小時 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m。耐久 30 km 的阻尼器約可承受 30,000/108 ≈ 278 小時此強度的振動；100 km 型約 926 小時。數值為教學假設。~With 5 mm amplitude at the damper and 1.5 Hz, each cycle travels 4×5 = 20 mm, about 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m per hour. A 30 km damper withstands about 30,000/108 ≈ 278 hours of such vibration; a 100 km type about 926 hours. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期目視檢查漏油、密封、支架與連接銷，並以監測資料估算每個阻尼器的累積行程，接近耐久值時排定更換；強風或颱風等事件後，抽查阻尼器行程極限是否被撞擊並複測代表性斜索的阻尼。~Inspect periodically for leaks, seals, brackets and pins, estimate each damper’s cumulative stroke from monitoring data and schedule replacement as it nears its rating; after strong-wind events check whether stroke limits were struck and re-measure damping on representative stays.
units.failure: 阻尼器漏油後阻尼係數下降，斜索在風雨中振動加劇，錨口疲勞與套管磨損加速；若沒有累積行程的估算，更換只能等到振動被民眾發現，屆時已累積可觀的疲勞損傷。~A leaking damper loses coefficient, stay vibration grows in wind and rain, and anchor-exit fatigue and duct wear accelerate; without cumulative-stroke estimates replacement waits until the public notices vibration, by which time considerable fatigue damage has accrued.
units.misconception: 阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。~Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed.
units.practice: 交接文件要列出每個阻尼器的型號、設定係數、行程、耐久值、安裝日期與更換程序，並提供備品清單；維護紀錄應把阻尼器檢查結果與監測振幅趨勢放在同一資料庫中比對。~Handover should list each damper’s type, coefficient setting, stroke, durability rating, installation date and replacement procedure, with a spares list; maintenance records should compare inspection findings with monitored amplitude trends in one database.

example: 設計練習：為一根長 300 m 的斜索選擇抑振方案。已知 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、固有阻尼 ζ₀ = 0.15%，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m，Sc₀ = 60×0.0015/0.032 ≈ 2.8，遠低於門檻約 10。方案 A：只用外置阻尼器，需 ζ ≥ 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%，附加阻尼至少 0.38%，所需位置 x_d ≥ 2×0.0038×300 ≈ 2.3 m（以最佳係數計）；保留 50% 餘裕取 ζ_add = 0.57%，x_d ≈ 3.4 m。方案 B：採用螺旋凸肋套管，若試驗證明門檻可放寬到約 5，則需 ζ ≥ 5×0.032/60 ≈ 0.27%，附加阻尼 0.12% 即可，x_d ≈ 0.72 m，內置阻尼器就可能達到；代價是阻力係數若由 0.55 增至 0.6，50 m/s 下每根索的風力由約 1,531×0.55×0.16×300 ≈ 40.4 kN 增至約 44.1 kN（+9%）。若索長改為 450 m，方案 A 的位置需增至約 5.1 m。數值為教學假設。~Design exercise: choose a suppression scheme for a 300 m stay with m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and inherent damping ζ₀ = 0.15%. With ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m, Sc₀ = 60×0.0015/0.032 ≈ 2.8, far below the threshold of about 10. Option A, external damper only: ζ ≥ 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53% requires at least 0.38% added damping, so the position is x_d ≥ 2×0.0038×300 ≈ 2.3 m at optimum coefficient; with 50% margin, ζ_add = 0.57% and x_d ≈ 3.4 m. Option B, helical-rib duct: if tests show the threshold can be relaxed to about 5, then ζ ≥ 5×0.032/60 ≈ 0.27% needs only 0.12% added damping and x_d ≈ 0.72 m, within reach of an internal damper; the price is drag rising from 0.55 to 0.6, so wind force per stay at 50 m/s goes from about 1,531×0.55×0.16×300 ≈ 40.4 kN to about 44.1 kN (+9%). For a 450 m stay, option A’s position grows to about 5.1 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
history: 1980 年代，日本名港西大橋的斜索在下雨且有風時出現大幅振動，Hikami 與 Shiraishi 於 1988 年發表研究，指出索面水線與風共同作用的機制，雨風振動從此成為斜張橋的重要課題。1995 年通車的諾曼第大橋與 1996 年通車的伊拉斯謨大橋都在通車後不久出現斜索大幅振動，分別加裝阻尼系統與調諧液壓阻尼器。此後業界發展出螺旋凸肋或凹窩套管、內外置阻尼器與交叉索等對策，fib Bulletin 30（2005）與 PTI 斜索建議把阻尼裝置與試驗要求納入規範，超長索則以數公尺高的阻尼器桅桿處理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不提供任何高空作業授權。~In the 1980s the stays of Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge vibrated heavily in wind with rain, and Hikami and Shiraishi’s 1988 paper identified the mechanism of rivulets on the cable surface acting with wind, making rain–wind vibration a major topic for cable-stayed bridges. The Pont de Normandie, opened in 1995, and the Erasmus Bridge, opened in 1996, both showed large stay vibration soon after opening and were fitted with damping systems and tuned hydraulic dampers respectively. Industry then developed helically ribbed or dimpled ducts, internal and external dampers and cross-ties, fib Bulletin 30 (2005) and the PTI stay recommendations codified damping devices and testing, and very long stays came to use damper masts several metres tall. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only and gives no authorisation for work at height.
facts: 1988 年 Hikami 與 Shiraishi 依名港西大橋觀測發表雨風振動機制~In 1988 Hikami and Shiraishi published the rain–wind mechanism based on Meiko-Nishi Bridge observations
工程上常引用的史庫頓數門檻約為 10~A commonly cited Scruton number threshold is about 10
內置彈性體阻尼器適用約 80 m 以下斜索，行程約 ±10 mm~Internal elastomeric dampers suit stays under about 80 m with about ±10 mm stroke
內置油壓阻尼器適用約 80 至 150 m，行程可達約 20 mm~Internal hydraulic dampers suit about 80 to 150 m with up to about 20 mm stroke
外置油壓阻尼器用於約 300 m 以上斜索，行程可達約 500 mm~External hydraulic dampers serve stays over about 300 m with up to about 500 mm stroke
雙螺旋凸紋主套管的阻力係數約 0.6~A double-spiral ribbed main duct has a drag coefficient of about 0.6
亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋以 7.4 m 桅桿支撐 ±920 mm 行程的油壓活塞~The Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge uses 7.4 m masts carrying hydraulic pistons with ±920 mm stroke
伊拉斯謨大橋 1996 年通車後出現雨風振動，約一年後加裝永久調諧液壓阻尼器~The Erasmus Bridge showed rain–wind vibration after its 1996 opening and got permanent tuned hydraulic dampers about a year later
